XiaomiSmartPenPlus / 焦点笔 Plus
Copyright 2026 XiaomiSmartPenPlus contributors

This merged application is based on XiaomiSmartPenPlus by BaerYiTo.
Reference project: https://github.com/BaerYiTo/XiaomiSmartPenPlus
The application source retains the Apache License, Version 2.0.
The interface uses Miuix under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
Changes include a left navigation rail, page transitions, automatic ROM adaptation,
ColorOS system pen integration, and a hardware status daemon for both magnetic
attachment directions. The retained COUI-Kit library source is no longer a runtime
dependency of the application and retains its own MPL-2.0 license.

The ColorOS backend was validated on Xiaomi Pad 6 Pro with a ColorOS 17 port.
Validation of this merged build and its HyperOS path is described separately.

This is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed
by, or an official product of Xiaomi or its associated companies. Product and
trademark names are used only to describe compatibility and belong to their
respective owners.

Third-party components retain their own copyrights and licenses.
See app/src/main/assets/third_party for their notices and license texts.
